long_description:
STRETCH, STRENGTHEN, & CUDDLE!
Ready to experience the ultimate fusion of fitness and furry fun? Join Goat Yoga DFW for a magical outdoor GOAT YOGILATES class at the beautiful BarnHill Vineyards! ?✨
Whether you want to tone your core with Pilates-inspired moves, find your flow with gentle yoga stretches, or just laugh while a baby goat uses your back as a stepping stone—this class has it all. All fitness levels are welcome!
Class runs from 1:00 PM – 2:00 PM
Your ticket includes an exclusive Goat Cuddle Playdate right after class from 2:00 PM – 3:00 PM! Stick around for extra snuggle time, photos, and standard winery fun.
BarnHill Vineyards (Anna, TX)
WHAT TO BRING & WEAR:
• Bring your own yoga mat or towel.
• Wear comfy clothes you don’t mind getting a little "hoofed up!" ?
Grab your friends, treat yourself to a glass of wine, and let the cutest goats in DFW guide you on a journey of pure joy and wellness.
SPOTS ARE LIMITED! Secure your tickets now before they sell out!
